description: External queue, for manual or agent use: report a claimed job as failed (POST /mt/jobs/{id}/fail). Every failure counts an attempt and retries with backoff, except cvrt_lang_mt_unsupported_language and cvrt_lang_mt_size, which fail for good. The message is dropped by the server. Returns { job, state }.

code.description: Failure code; the server maps an unlisted one to external_error

message.description: Free text; the server drops it

token.description: Lease token of the claimed job: the `lease` value lang_list_pending returned for it (64 hex characters)

name: lang_fail_job
